fields.content: ✅ Reading window is open — the PPD can be read today (48–72 hours after placement).

conditions.expression: (function(){ var d = responses['ppd-date-tested']; if (!d || typeof d !== 'string') return false; var placed = new Date(d); if (isNaN(placed.getTime())) return false; var now = new Date(); var diffHours = (now - placed) / 3600000; return diffHours >= 48 && diffHours <= 72; })()

fields.content: ⚠️ Outside the reading window — the PPD should be read between 48 and 72 hours after placement. Please contact your clinic.

fields.question: Result (calculated)
fields.calculation: (function(){ var mm = responses['induration-mm']; var immune = responses['immune-status']; if (mm === '' || mm === undefined || mm === null) return ''; var n = parseFloat(mm); if (isNaN(n)) return 'Invalid measurement'; var threshold = 10; if (immune === 'hiv-high' || immune === 'transplant' || immune === 'close-contact') threshold = 5; else if (immune === 'hiv-low') threshold = 5; return n >= threshold ? 'POSITIVE (' + n + ' mm — threshold ' + threshold + ' mm)' : 'Negative (' + n + ' mm — threshold ' + threshold + ' mm)'; })()
